messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — NVIDIA pushed driver 535.86 and AMD rolled ROCm 5.7 to partner channels this morning. Some marketplace vendors are seeing a perf/regression signal with our prefix/KV cache on CUDA 535.x. Need to triage before we sign off on joint listings.

tanya: Noted. Which marketplace images are at risk? AWS/GCP vendor bundles? Any customers hit yet?

alex: Primarily AWS Marketplace AMIs and a couple of managed images we ship to HPE/Dell partners. No direct customer P1s yet, but partner QA flagged flakiness in long-sequence LM tests.

chris: Can we get CI diffs? I want kernel module + cuDNN version matrix. vendor-ci-bot: CI run 2026-03-18_09:12 failed on nightly/cuda-535 with fallback test: 
```
RuntimeError: KV cache mismatch at step 220
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/e2e/prefix_cache_test.py", line 143, in test_long_prefix
    assert out1 == out2
```

maria: Interesting — that looks like a cache key hashing change. ROCm 5.7 change log mentioned small ABI tweaks in the memory allocator. Could be related.

chris: Action items: 1) Pin marketplace images to last known-good driver (NVIDIA 534.86, ROCm 5.6) for the next deploy. 2) Create hotfix branch for runtime to add defensive KV checksum. 3) Run canary on Dedicated pools with 10% traffic.

alex: Agreed. @tanya can you coordinate messaging with marketplace contacts (AWS, GCP, HPE)? We should delay joint announcement until we confirm fixes or provide a pinned image note.

jordan: Ops note — pinning images is low-risk but we need to ensure we don't break autoscaler images. I'll prepare image tags: 
```
redwood/runtime:2026-03-18-gpu-nv534
redwood/runtime:2026-03-18-rocm56
```
I'll add a deprecation header for the new images in console.

sam: FYI from partner eng side: NVIDIA partner team already put out a compat advisory, but it's soft. They'll push a patched driver if we give repro steps. I can open an escalation ticket but need a reproducer and kernel / distro details.

chris: I'll generate a small repro harness and attach to the ticket. Also adding quick mitigation: checksum guard in KV cache (hotfix) so behavior is deterministic even if allocator layout changes. Patch ETA: 24h.

maria: While chris builds the hotfix, we should run full evals against the pinned images + the new ones to measure regressions. I'll queue prompt sets overnight and compare token-level divergence.

alex: Messaging plan: tanya to partners with recommended pinned images + ETA for fix. Marketing announcement postponed until we have stability confirmed in canary. If partners insist on publishing, include explicit driver pin instructions.

tanya: I'll send two short notes: 1) Private note to AWS/GCP/HPE partner reps with the pin & mitigation steps. 2) Public marketplace advisory draft (non-fearful): recommend image tags, list known affected combos, and temporary workaround. Draft to you @alex for review in 2 hours.

vendor-ci-bot: Canary run scheduled by jordan for 2026-03-18T15:00Z on 10% Dedicated pool. Jobs: canary/e2e-prefix-cache, perf/latency.

deploy-bot: Rolling pin of marketplace image tags initiated. Will block auto-updates for 48h.

chris: Quick technical note for the ticket: include command to reproduce inside container: 
```
# run with pinned driver image
docker run --gpus all --rm -e NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=compute,utility \
  redwood/runtime:2026-03-18-gpu-nv534 \
  python tests/e2e/prefix_cache_test.py::test_long_prefix -k long_prefix
```
Also include the kernel: uname -a output in the ticket.

sam: I'll loop in NVIDIA partner eng contact (cc: nv-partners@nvendor.com) and AMD partner eng if we need ROCm follow-up.

alex: Ok timeline: today — pin images & notify partners; tomorrow — hotfix branch + CI; day after — canary verification, perf comparison. If canary passes, we unfreeze marketplace listing and resume announcement cadence.

maria: I'll post a results summary (token divergence, latency delta, flakiness count) in #eng-runtime when done.

tanya: Draft sent to partners. Alex, quick thumbs if OK: "We recommend pinning to runtime tags redwood/runtime:2026-03-18-gpu-nv534 and redwood/runtime:2026-03-18-rocm56 while we validate a hotfix. We will update this thread with canary results."

alex: 👍 Looks good. Add expected timeline line (24–48h).

jordan: Canary started. Initial health: 98% pass on short sequences, long-prefix test in progress. Will update at 1h mark. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

(1h later)

jordan: Canary update: long-prefix failures dropped from 12 -> 1 in canary after runtime checksum guard applied in hotfix branch. Perf within 3% of pinned images.

alex: That's encouraging. @tanya please tell partners we have a hotfix and canary looks good; we'll keep images pinned for 48h post-unfreeze.

tanya: Message sent to partners. AWS said they'll hold off on listing changes and will reference our pinned tags. GCP wants the public advisory but will include the pin guidance.

chris: I'll open PR to merge hotfix to main with test coverage and a short migration note for Marketplace images.

maria: Running full overnight evals; will report divergences in morning thread update.

alex: Great work team — consensus path executed. We'll reconvene if any partner escalations come in. Thanks all. :rocket:
